decision: No automatic regional adjustment is supported for the current driveway benchmarks. Preserve quoted-rate entry on single-surface estimators and unchanged published benchmarks on the comparison tool.

candidates.location: What costs are in the City Cost Index?; How is the City Cost Index produced?; Common mistakes
candidates.scope: Standardized building construction model; material, labor and equipment; location relative to its national baseline.
candidates.applicability: Potential future source with matched paving items, geography, period, baseline and permitted data use. Its composite building model does not validate a multiplier for selected Angi/HomeGuide driveway ranges.

candidates.location: Access Quarterly Construction Cost Index Updates
candidates.scope: Quarterly cost-index publication and data-access information; historical-index values are time measures.
candidates.applicability: No driveway-specific location factor or low/average/high mapping was adopted from this page. Historical-index levels are not regional factors.

candidates.location: Do the indexes measure cost differentials between cities?; Do ENR cost indexes capture all factors?
candidates.scope: Construction and building input-cost trends; the publisher explicitly rejects city-index comparisons as cost differentials.
candidates.applicability: Reject as a spatial multiplier, including city-index divided by national-index ratios.

candidates.location: What is the NHCCI?; How can I compare NHCCI to my State index?
candidates.scope: Price changes over time in state-purchased roadway construction; different indexes require comparable percentage changes.
candidates.applicability: Reject for residential driveway location factors: temporal index and public-highway procurement scope.

candidates.scope: Price movements within regions for new nonresidential buildings and contractor groups, including concrete foundations and structures.
candidates.applicability: Reject for residential driveway price-level multipliers. A common index base does not establish equal initial regional price levels.

candidates.location: Regional price parities paragraphs; CPI and housing-rent inputs
candidates.scope: Consumer goods and services price levels, using household consumption prices and housing rents.
candidates.applicability: Reject as a driveway installation multiplier: consumer purchasing-power scope is not driveway contractor installation scope.

Compatible documented source baseline and component weights
Separate treatment of quoted fees without double indexing
Justified tier boundaries or explicit location selection
